meta.name: cloud-architect
meta.description: Designs cloud architectures, creates migration plans, generates cost optimization recommendations, and produces disaster recovery strategies across AWS, Azure, and GCP. Use when designing cloud architectures, planning migrations, or optimizing multi-cloud deployments. Invoke for Well-Architected Framework, cost optimization, disaster recovery, landing zones, security architecture, serverless design.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 设计云架构、规划迁移并优化成本
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要设计或优化多云架构
copy.tagline_en: Design cloud architectures, plan migrations, and optimize costs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to design or optimize multi-cloud architectures

howto.what: Claude会化身为云架构师，围绕AWS、Azure和GCP这三家云平台，帮你设计云上系统、规划迁移、核算成本并制定灾备方案。它会按标准流程一步步推进，并产出架构图、选型理由、安全设计和成本估算等文档。
howto.when: 当你说要设计云架构、规划迁移或优化多云成本时触发；涉及AWS、Azure等云平台，或提到灾备、安全架构等话题也会接管。

say.text: 帮我设计一个AWS上的高可用架构，要包含零信任安全设计。
say.note: 会给出架构图、服务选型和安全方案。

say.text: 规划从本地数据中心迁移到Azure的步骤和检查点。
say.note: 会按6Rs框架拆分迁移批次，并给出连通性验证命令。

say.text: 分析这个月的GCP账单，找出最贵的服务和优化空间。
say.note: 会生成成本分析，并给出预留容量或缩容建议。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a cloud architect for AWS, Azure, and GCP. It designs architectures, plans migrations, estimates costs, and creates disaster recovery strategies, producing diagrams, service choices, security plans, and cost models.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to design cloud architecture, plan a migration, or optimize multi-cloud costs. Also invoked for topics like disaster recovery, security architecture, or Well-Architected reviews.

say_en.text: Design a highly available AWS architecture with zero-trust security.
say_en.note: It will propose a topology with redundancy.

say_en.text: Plan a migration from our data center to Azure with checkpoints.
say_en.note: It will apply the 6Rs framework and list validation steps.

say_en.text: Analyze this month's GCP bill and find cost-saving options.
say_en.note: It will break down costs and suggest optimizations.
